scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @readio/web" "cd apps/api && TTS_FALLBACK_ORDER=minimax uv run --all-groups uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @readio/web && npm run build --workspace @readio/extension
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/web/.next apps/web/.next-dev apps/extension/dist apps/extension/.cache
